test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Team India scored runs in the first 30 overs in an ODI match at an average of 5.6 runs per over. What is the required runs per over in the remaining 20 overs at which the team has to score to meet a total target of 320?
solution:
**Given: **

Run rate (R1) for first 30 overs = 5.6 runs per over

Total target (T) = 320 runs

Total number of overs = 50

**FORMULA USED:**

Total runs = Run rate × no. of overs

**Calculations:**

For first 30 overs,

Total runs (T1) = R1 x no. of overs

⇒ 5.6 × 30 = 168 runs

For next 20 overs,

Total runs (T2) = T - T1

⇒ 320 - 168 = 152 runs

Now Run rate (R2) = T2 / no. of overs 

⇒ 152 / 20 = 7.6 runs per over.

**∴ Team India needs run rate of 7.6 runs per over to achieve the target of 320 runs.**
